row.notes: Creates and initialises a rigid body from a descriptor (param_2) in the world (param_1): allocates and zeroes the body block, copies mass/inertia/shape data, builds inverse inertia, calls Car_RigidBody_IntegrateState and Ne_PhysWorld_UpdateBodyBroadphase and links the body into the world (0x1440c1dd0); allocation failure sets ENOMEM 0xc in the TLS error ring. Callers Ne_PhysDeform_BuildTyreWallSoftBody and ~20 physics/tyre/mover builders. Hypothesis.
